description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5340016164207 LOCK-TAG OUT,SECURI: Line 0001 Qty 31 UI KT Deliver To: By: 0032 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
